chapters.title: Introduction
lines: Meet the Tactical Valkyries - weapon girls who fell from the future - build machines that bend industry and time, and fight the machines and bosses of a corrupted world.
## Reading this guide
- Pick a chapter on the left; scroll with the mouse wheel
- You get one guide the first time you join. Craft another from a book + chrono scrap
## Helpful extras
- JEI for recipes. Blueprint cards accept JEI's [+] button
- Advancements (L) have three tabs: Tactical Valkyries, Chronolink and Battlefield
## The overall flow
- Find a crashed pod and wake the sleeping valkyrie
- Gather materials, build machines, climb the power and circuit tiers
- Build weapons for yourself and your valkyries, then raid corrupted bases
- Raise your Chronolink machines to T4 (Neverlast) for the strongest gear and the final foe

chapters.title: Early Game: Pods and Waking
lines: ## Find a crashed pod
Charred crashed pods lie half-buried around the world, each holding a sleeping valkyrie, a Damaged Interface and a chest.
@automata_valkyries:valkyrie_radar Valkyrie Radar: right-click for the direction and distance of the nearest sleeping valkyrie (up to 2,000 m)
## Wake a valkyrie
@automata_valkyries:core_proto Proto Core: made in the Assembler (see JEI)
- Charge it to full (100,000 FE) in a Battery's charging slot
- Right-click the pod's Damaged Interface with a full Proto Core: the sleeping valkyrie within 6 blocks wakes and you become her owner
> Set earlyGame.easyPodWake to true to wake them without a Proto Core
## Afterwards
- Right-click her empty-handed to open her menu
- Mine ores and build a generator and basic machines next

chapters.title: Materials and Ores
lines: ## Ores unique to this mod
@automata_valkyries:ingot_astrite Astrite: the first metal, used for tools, machines and weapons
@automata_valkyries:ingot_phononium Phononium
@automata_valkyries:ingot_ceruleas Ceruleas
@automata_valkyries:crystal_luminal Luminal Crystal: from luminal ore; the heart of power and circuits
@automata_valkyries:drop_chrono_scrap Chrono scrap and nanomachines: dropped by machine enemies
## Shared metals
- 8 ores (tin, lead, silver, nickel, zinc, aluminum, osmium, uranium) and 6 alloys (steel, bronze, brass, electrum, invar, constantan), shared with other tech mods through forge tags
- Plates (2 ingots) and wires (3 ingots) can also be crafted by hand
> Electrum needs no alloy smelter: mix gold and silver dust by hand and smelt it
## Compression
- 9 of a tier make 1 of the next: block > orb > star > core
- Shared-metal orbs, stars and cores upgrade the Observation Cubes
## Higher alloys
@automata_valkyries:ingot_stellachronodyme Luminal Sterling, Chrono Fortress, Tachyon Accel, Eclipse Biometal and Stellachronodyme are made by the Luminal Adapter's phase transition

chapters.title: Machines and Power
lines: @automata_valkyries:generator Generator: burns fuel for FE
@automata_valkyries:battery Battery: stores power and charges items such as the Proto Core
@automata_valkyries:power_cable Power Cable: carries power

## Valkyrie operators
- A valkyrie standing next to a machine boosts it based on her sync rate (capped by the machine's tier)

lines: @automata_valkyries:circuit_basic Basic Circuit > Advanced Circuit

chapters.title: Chronolink Machines
lines: ## Tiers
- T1 High-End > T2 Future > T3 Beyond > T4 Neverlast, raised with tier frames or upgrade kits
@automata_valkyries:luminal_reactor Luminal Reactor: power. Fuel: crystal > block > orb (T2) > star (T3) > Genesis Luminal Core (T4). At T4 a Genesis Core in the core slot generates forever
@automata_valkyries:luminal_adapter Luminal Energy Adapter: phase transitions
@automata_valkyries:chrono_smelter Chrono Smelter: doubles ores
@automata_valkyries:chrono_fabricator Chrono Fabricator: crafts blueprint card recipes from linked inputs
@automata_valkyries:tether_pylon Tether Pylon: powers machines in range
@automata_valkyries:void_repository Void Repository: huge storage
@automata_valkyries:tactical_armory Tactical Armory: assembles weapons and gear
@automata_valkyries:charging_dock Charging Dock: charges and repairs valkyries
@automata_valkyries:chrono_accelerator Time Accelerator and Time Rewinder
@automata_valkyries:tool_chrono_tuner Chrono Tuner: sneak + right-click a target, then right-click a machine to link it (IN / OUT / BOTH)
@automata_valkyries:blueprint_card Blueprint Card: hold the wanted item in your offhand and right-click; with an empty offhand it opens a screen that accepts JEI's [+]
## Void Repository
- Search box (JEI syntax). Japanese names also match kana and romaji
- Pack: compresses 9-to-1 above 64 (uses power). Right-click an item for a stock rule kept in output links (uses power)
- Click the power gauge to accept power from Tether Pylons (off by default)

chapters.title: Tactical Valkyries
lines: - Types: V (all-round), S (assault), H (heavy), C (command)
- Right-click empty-handed: menu. Right-click with a treat or repair item: give it
- Sneak + right-click her head: pat. Her body: follow / wait
- Modes: follow, wait, defend, patrol
- 100,000 FE inside, refilled from her chest core. At 0 she sleeps until recharged
- At 0 HP she shuts down instead of dying; repair her with nanomachine solution or a Charging Dock
- Sync rate rises with care and makes her stronger; tactical codes need it
@automata_valkyries:tactical_remote Command Remote, Motion Remote, Emergency Recall, Rescue Communicator, Valkyrie Storage and Stretcher help you manage them

chapters.title: Valkyrie Gear
lines: - Armor frames (head, chest, legs), a back unit, logic chips, weapons in both hands, a chest core and ammo
@automata_valkyries:core_basic Cores: Basic > High-Density > Singularity > Chrono Genesis > Stella Genesis Omega
@automata_valkyries:backpack_harvester Non-combat units (farming, ranching, mining, logging, fishing, cooking, support) make her work instead of fight and flee to you when in danger

chapters.title: Weapons and Upgrades
lines: - T1-T4 weapons from the Tactical Armory run on power with melee, a skill (right-click) and charge attacks; valkyries use them too
- One-handed weapons in both hands: dual wield
@automata_valkyries:upgrade_station Weapon Upgrade Station: +10% per upgrade to attack, speed, charge/cooldown and capacity (up to +1000%)
@automata_valkyries:overload_memory Overload Memory: from clearing every recollection trial; overloads a weapon at a crafting table
@automata_valkyries:tool_flight_wing Light Wing Flyer (T3): fly while holding it
@automata_valkyries:tool_drill_t1 Drills and chainsaws; the T4 drill breaks bedrock

chapters.title: Tactical Codes
lines: @automata_valkyries:tool_tac_pointer Tactical Pointer: V (or sneak + right-click) picks a code; hold right-click 1 s and release to call it where you look
- A nearby valkyrie of yours with enough sync and power approves it
- CARPET, GUNGNIR, ABYSS, COMET, IRIS
> enableTacticalGriefing and tacticalAffectsBosses are off by default

chapters.title: Handy Items
lines: @automata_valkyries:item_pocket_t1 Item Pocket: auto-uses totems, potions and food from inside. 27/54/108/216 slots
- T2 stacks unstackables to 16; T3 stacks to 64 and auto-collects; T4 refills your hand, has a magnet, keeps items on death and opens a linked Void Repository from anywhere
@automata_valkyries:akashic_cubes Observation Cubes: orbiting cubes shoot nearby enemies; upgrade them at an anvil with shared-metal orbs, stars and cores

chapters.title: Corrupted Bases and Bosses
lines: - T0 warehouse > T1 outpost > T2 factory > T3 sky garden fortress, each with a boss deep inside
- Bases get more common the farther you go from the world spawn (higher tiers ramp up farther out)
@automata_valkyries:base_radar Corrupted Base Radar: right-click for the nearest base; sneak + right-click to choose which kind
@automata_valkyries:chrono_key Chrono Key: after the Bastion Keeper falls, wakes the fortress gate to the Time Rift, where the Time Ruler waits
> Something more may lie beyond...

chapters.title: Heroes, Elenor and Recollections
lines: @automata_valkyries:signal_luxion Hero signals (Luxion, Gallia Fort, Memento Mori), the Akashic terminal and Elenor's invitation summon bosses
- Each hero signal needs a rare drop from regular base enemies (player kills only; Looting helps):
@automata_valkyries:photon_blade_shard Photon Blade Shard (Luxion): 3% from Chrono Troopers
@automata_valkyries:distortion_core_shard Distortion Core Shard (Gallia Fort): 5% from Heavy Walkers
@automata_valkyries:black_death_cocoon Black Death Cocoon (Memento Mori): 6% from Mask Drones

@automata_valkyries:boss_drop_memory_stella Memory of Luminal Stella: right-click to rematch defeated foes in recollection trials (you keep your items if you die). Clear them all for the Overload Memory

chapters.title: Settings and Controls
lines: - V: tactical code   H: valkyrie HUD   J: HUD layout
- automata_valkyries-valkyries.toml: earlyGame.easyPodWake, enableTacticalGriefing, tacticalAffectsBosses
- Machine config: Time Accelerator limits and Time Rewinder ores (off by default)
## With other mods
- Jade shows machine tiers and links, and valkyrie owner, state, power, shield and sync
- Curios: Item Pocket in a belt slot, Observation Cubes in a charm slot, Light Wing Flyer in a back slot (fly while worn)
- Mekanism: astrite, phononium and ceruleas ores double in the Enrichment Chamber
- AE2 / Refined Storage connect to the Void Repository and machines through storage buses; porter-chip valkyries deliver pickups to ME interfaces too
- Basic and advanced circuits are interchangeable with other mods' circuits of the same tier (e.g. Mekanism control circuits)
- Create: crushing wheels turn this mod's ores into dust; the press makes shared-metal plates
- Immersive Engineering / Thermal: their crushers double this mod's ores into dust too
- EMI shows this mod's recipe screens when JEI is installed too
